from.name: Rudi Desmet
from.org: Intercommunale Afval West, a regional waste collection service

subject: Route training for our drivers
mail: Since we redesigned our collection routes in September, our drivers keep missing bins and complaints have doubled. I'd like a route training for all 45 drivers. Maybe with a map quiz?
snippets: 45 drivers, most with 10+ years of experience.
Routes are delivered on a tablet app that gives turn-by-turn directions.
why: The drivers follow the app, and the app is wrong, so the fix is the route data, not the drivers.

hidden_facts.fact: Since the September update, the app lists some streets in the wrong order and skips cul-de-sacs entirely.
hidden_facts.reveal_line: The app skips dead-end streets. All of them. It doesn't believe in dead ends.

hidden_facts.fact: The three drivers who still use their own paper maps miss almost no bins.
hidden_facts.reveal_line: Funny thing: the three old-school guys with their paper maps hardly miss anything.

debrief: Experienced people suddenly making the same mistake after a change points at the change, not at them. When the drivers who ignore the tool perform best, the tool is the problem. Report the route data errors to the app supplier; a map quiz would only teach drivers to distrust their equipment.
